blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—Nick Hornsby understands that the duration of his stint with TNT depends on if and when Rondae Hollis-Jefferson is ready to make his long-awaited return in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup. Regardless of whether his stint turns out to be short or lengthy, Hornsby is keen on helping put the Tropang 5G in a position to achieve their ultimate goal, as he showed with his performance on Saturday. “I don’t feel any ill-will about it,” Hornsby said after TNT’s 116-98 victory over San Miguel Beer at Ynares Center here. “I know what my job is.
